annotations.before: Validate mathematical expression syntax against grammar
annotations.after: Check only the native mathematical grammar and return a plain-text syntax verdict. Read that text: syntax errors can be returned with isError=false. This does not evaluate the expression, validate Python source, or establish secure execution. The native grammar accepts ^ for exponentiation and rejects Python **.
